name: richos-service
description: RichOS local service (P1). The native, no-network process outside the browser: native-messaging host + drop-zone watcher + the surface-independent transcription pipeline (ffmpeg normalize -> whisper.cpp large-v3-turbo-q5_0 per channel -> merge + caption fold-in -> loro-correction seam -> transcript.md + verification + ingest ledger + retranscribe). Reuses the extension's pure reconcile logic verbatim.
